speedrun-board-consistency: Runs on this board are re-scored from their own log and checked for impossible claims, then reviewed before they rank.
speedrun-board-deterministic: Runs on this board are re-simulated from their inputs. A run that does not reproduce is rejected automatically.
speedrun-board-empty-body: Record a replay in the game, then submit it here. First one on the board sets the record.
speedrun-board-manual: This game cannot be verified automatically yet — every run is reviewed by hand.
speedrun-description: Every run points at a replay, and the replay is re-simulated from its own inputs — so a record is proved, not vouched for.
speedrun-no-board-for-version: No board open for this version
speedrun-no-boards-body: A speedrun board is a category on one game version. An admin opens the first ones.
speedrun-seed-failed: Could not open the starter boards
speedrun-submit-none: No unsubmitted recordings for this game. Finish a run with replay capture on and it will appear here.
speedrun-submit-queued: Run submitted — it is in review
speedrun-tier-consistency: Checked for consistency and re-scored, but this game’s log cannot be proved — a human reviews it.
speedrun-tier-deterministic: Re-simulated from the run’s own inputs — the result cannot be forged.
speedrun-tier-manual: This game has no automatic verifier, so runs are reviewed by hand.
